props.name: config
props.description: Configuration applied while this provider is mounted.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Explicit enabled override; omitted keeps `config.enabled` or the current state.

props.name: tag
props.description: Render element. The provider uses `display: contents` by default.

props.name: restoreOnUnmount
props.description: Restore the previous global telemetry configuration on unmount.

props.name: trackLifecycle
props.description: Record provider mount/unmount lifecycle events when telemetry is enabled.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label when a visible wrapper tag is used.

props.name: eager
props.description: Apply changes immediately before mount (useful for SSR-safe setup).

props.name: display
props.description: Wrapper layout mode; contents preserves zero-layout behavior.
